Hello Tron, First of all, thank you for your amazing work on WTT-Armory. The mod adds a lot of depth and variety to the game, and it’s clear how much effort has gone into creating all the new models and equipment. I wanted to share a suggestion that could make the mod even more flexible and user-friendly, especially for those of us running SPT servers with FIKA and FIKA Headless. The challenge Currently, the client has to load all of the bundles included in the mod, even if only a small portion of the equipment is actually used in-game. This can lead to:

  • longer client loading times,
  • higher memory usage,
  • unnecessary network and server load. The idea It would be very helpful to have a configuration option before server startup that allows administrators to choose which categories (or even specific items) of equipment should be enabled. Possible approaches could be:
  • A server config file (e.g. config.json) where categories like weapons, armor, helmets, backpacks, etc. can be toggled on or off.
  • A separate config file with more detailed control, allowing admins to disable individual items or groups.
  • Optionally, a “minimal set” preset (for example, only weapons without custom armor or backpacks). Benefits
  • Optimized performance for both clients and servers.
  • Flexibility for server admins to tailor the mod to their specific scenarios.
  • Reduced issues for players with limited hardware resources.
  • Broader appeal of the mod thanks to its adaptability. Closing This is just a suggestion for improvement, not a criticism — WTT-Armory is already a fantastic addition to SPT. I believe such a feature would make it even more powerful and convenient. If you ever decide to implement it, I’d be glad to help with testing and provide feedback. Thanks again for your hard work and for sharing it with the community! Best regards, Andrey
